troubleshooting.symptoms: Seat leakage, gland leakage, stiff handwheel, vibration/noise, unexpected pressure drop.
troubleshooting.possible_causes: Disc/seat wear, packing damage, deposits, bent stem, incorrect operation.
troubleshooting.diagnostic_steps: Check valve position, inspect bonnet and gland, verify smooth travel, compare upstream/downstream readings.

troubleshooting.verification_steps: Confirm no leakage, verify correct valve position, check line pressure/flow stability, obtain engineer acceptance after maintenance.
troubleshooting.prevention_measures: Inspect packing and seating surfaces, operate smoothly, maintain per maker recommendations.

troubleshooting.symptoms: Disc/seat passing, external shaft leakage, stiff gearbox, incomplete opening or closing.
troubleshooting.possible_causes: Worn or contaminated seat, damaged disc edge, gearbox wear, shaft misalignment, loose flange bolts.
troubleshooting.diagnostic_steps: Check tag and line state, inspect body and shaft for leakage, compare gearbox indicator with disc position, verify upstream/downstream pressure using approved instruments.
troubleshooting.immediate_action: Stop operation if abnormal leakage or binding occurs, notify the responsible engineer, isolate and depressurize under vessel procedure before inspection. Do not force the gearbox.
troubleshooting.verification_steps: Confirm no leakage, verify correct valve position, check line pressure/flow stability, obtain engineer acceptance after maintenance.
troubleshooting.prevention_measures: Inspect gearbox, shaft, disc and seat, exercise only when permitted, follow maker lubrication and service intervals.

specifications.material: Body: cast steel; spring: alloy steel; trim: stainless steel

usecase: Safety / Relief Valve (Globe / Angle) for Diesel Oil (D.O.) Filling & Transfer System.

troubleshooting.failure_condition: Failure to lift / failure to reseat
troubleshooting.symptoms: Unwanted discharge, failure to lift at set pressure, failure to reseat, chatter or outlet leakage.
troubleshooting.possible_causes: Incorrect set pressure, contaminated seat, spring deterioration, blocked discharge path, damaged trim.
troubleshooting.diagnostic_steps: Treat discharge as a safety event, verify pressure indication and discharge route, compare against certified set-pressure record. Do not adjust in service.
troubleshooting.immediate_action: Alert responsible engineer immediately, keep clear of discharge, never gag, isolate or adjust except under authorized procedure.
troubleshooting.verification_steps: Confirm no leakage, verify correct valve position, check line pressure/flow stability, obtain engineer acceptance after maintenance.
troubleshooting.prevention_measures: Maintain certification and inspection records, keep discharge path clear, arrange authorized periodic testing.
